description: This file contains unit tests for the WideAreaGatewayDiscovery module. It defines a test suite 'WideAreaGatewayDiscoveryTests' with two test cases that verify discovery of gateways and handling of potential security issues. Additionally, it includes a test-specific class 'NameserverQueryLog' for logging DNS queries during tests.

classes.name: NameserverQueryLog
classes.description: A test utility class that logs DNS nameserver queries for verification in tests.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Logs a nameserver query in the NameserverQueryLog.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of queries matching a specific nameserver.
